question: A hemispherical bowl has 7 cm radius. It is to be painted inside as well as outside. The cost (in Rs.) of painting it at the rate of Rs. 6 per 4 cm² is: (Take pi = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

Radius (r) = 7 cm

Cost per 4 cm² = Rs. 6

Formula used:-

Curved Surface Area of Hemisphere = 2πr²

Total surface area to be painted = Surface area (inside) + Surface area (outside)

**Calculations:**

Surface area (inside) = 2π(7)² = 2π(49) = 2 × (22/7) × 49

⇒ Surface area (inside) = 308 cm²

Total Surface Area = Inside Surface Area + Outside Surface Area

Total Surface Area = 308 cm2 + 308 cm2 

Total Surface Area = 616 cm2 

The cost of painting this area at the given rate of Rs. 6 per 4 cm2

Cost = (Total Surface Area / 4 cm²) × Rs. 6

Cost = (616 / 4) × 6 = Rs. 924 

**∴The cost of painting of the hemispherical Rs.924 **
